capabilities.fastIOS: Derived from the built app in 0.2 s: 18 services kept, 155 off, each kept one with its reason.
capabilities.name: Profile from the built app
capabilities.simslim: No app reading: a hand-written --profile JSON, or --except/--keep flags (simslim 0.14.0 help).

capabilities.fastIOS: `fast-ios heal` sees the app fail to reach a service that is off and turns it on with no reboot, then saves it to the app's profile. Not timed by bench: it needs the app to call the service (see README, Self-repair).
capabilities.name: Repair while the app runs
capabilities.simslim: `simslim enable <udid> <ids>` turns services on live, but you must know which ones.

notes: Parallel agents run with FASTIOS_TEMPLATE=off, so every agent creates its simulator; lease admission queues boots while memory is short.
List commands run on the default device set: `fast-ios status --json` and `simslim list` (simslim also scans Xcode's testing set).
simslim's time is `simslim on`, its one-shot command; `simslim watch` can also slim before the first boot and is not measured here.
